rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊I'd love to keep talking with￥you, but we can't, can we?￥Shall we start training?＞
＊Natsuno＊There's no point going on￥about this forever.￥Let's start training.＞
＊Natsuno＊Sorry to cut this short,￥but I think we really￥ought to train now.＞
＊Natsuno＊We could talk all day,￥but it's time we￥started training.＞
